mapper.sql:
select p.*,u.user_name,u.nick_name,u.avatar,m.merchant_id visible_merchant_id,m.shop_name merchant_name,(select count(*) from shop_zhenke_post_comment c where c.post_id=p.post_id and c.del_flag='0') comment_count,(select count(*) from shop_zhenke_post_useful x where x.post_id=p.post_id) useful_count,
exists(select 1 from shop_zhenke_post_useful x where x.post_id=p.post_id and x.shop_user_id=#{currentUserId}) 0
useful_by_me from shop_zhenke_post p join shop_user u on u.user_id=p.shop_user_id and u.del_flag='0' join shop_place pl on pl.place_id=p.place_id and pl.status='0' left join shop_merchant m on m.merchant_id=p.merchant_id and m.del_flag='0' and m.audit_status='APPROVED' and m.status='0'
mapper.select: select * from shop_place where provider=#{provider} and provider_place_id=#{providerPlaceId} and status='0'
select * from shop_place where place_id=#{placeId} and status='0'

select p.place_city from shop_zhenke_post p join shop_place pl on pl.place_id=p.place_id and pl.status='0' where p.del_flag='0' and p.status='PUBLISHED' and p.place_city is not null and trim(p.place_city) != '' and p.place_city=#{scopeCity} and p.perspective='LOCAL' and p.perspective='TOURIST' and p.perspective='HOMETOWNER' group by p.place_city order by max(p.published_at) desc,max(p.post_id) desc
where p.post_id=#{postId} and p.del_flag='0' and p.status='PUBLISHED'
select * from shop_zhenke_post_resource where post_id=#{postId} order by resource_sort,resource_id
select * from shop_zhenke_post_resource where post_id in #{postId} order by post_id,resource_sort,resource_id
mapper.update: update shop_zhenke_upload set claimed_post_id=#{postId},claim_time=sysdate() where shop_user_id=#{shopUserId} and resource_url=#{resourceUrl} and resource_type=#{resourceType} and claimed_post_id is null and expire_time>sysdate()

update shop_zhenke_post set del_flag='2',status='DELETED',featured_flag='0',featured_at=null,featured_by=null,delete_source='AUTHOR',delete_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where post_id=#{postId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId} and del_flag='0' and status='PUBLISHED'

update shop_zhenke_post set del_flag='2',status='DELETED',featured_flag='0',featured_at=null,featured_by=null,delete_source='ADMIN',deleted_by=#{adminId},delete_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where post_id=#{postId} and del_flag='0'

update shop_zhenke_post set featured_flag='1',featured_at=sysdate(),featured_by=#{adminId},featured_version=featured_version+1,update_time=sysdate() where post_id=#{postId} and del_flag='0' and status='PUBLISHED' and featured_flag='0'
update shop_zhenke_post set featured_flag='0',featured_at=null,featured_by=null,update_time=sysdate() where post_id=#{postId} and del_flag='0' and status='PUBLISHED' and featured_flag='1'
mapper.insert: insert ignore into shop_zhenke_post_useful(post_id,shop_user_id,create_time) select #{postId},#{shopUserId},sysdate() from shop_zhenke_post where post_id=#{postId} and del_flag='0' and status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.delete: delete from shop_zhenke_post_useful where post_id=#{postId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from shop_zhenke_post_useful where post_id=#{postId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId}
select count(*) from shop_zhenke_post_useful useful join shop_zhenke_post post on post.post_id=useful.post_id where post.shop_user_id=#{shopUserId} and post.del_flag='0' and post.status='PUBLISHED'

select 'POST' content_type, post.post_id content_id, post.title, left(coalesce(nullif(trim(post.suggestion),''),post.content),240) summary, (select resource.resource_url from shop_zhenke_post_resource resource where resource.post_id=post.post_id and resource.resource_type='IMAGE' order by resource.resource_sort,resource.resource_id limit 1) cover_url, useful.useful_count, post.published_at, concat('/posts/',post.post_id) detail_path from shop_zhenke_post post join ( select post_id,count(*) useful_count from shop_zhenke_post_useful group by post_id ) useful on useful.post_id=post.post_id where post.shop_user_id=#{shopUserId} and post.del_flag='0' and post.status='PUBLISHED' order by post.published_at desc,post.post_id desc
mapper.sql: select c.*,u.user_name,u.nick_name,u.avatar,rc.shop_user_id reply_to_shop_user_id,coalesce(ru.nick_name,ru.user_name) reply_to_name,c.shop_user_id=p.shop_user_id post_author,case when c.parent_comment_id is null then (select count(*) from shop_zhenke_post_comment reply_count where reply_count.post_id=c.post_id and reply_count.parent_comment_id=c.comment_id and reply_count.del_flag='0') else 0 end reply_count from shop_zhenke_post_comment c join shop_zhenke_post p on p.post_id=c.post_id and p.del_flag='0' join shop_user u on u.user_id=c.shop_user_id left join shop_zhenke_post_comment rc on rc.comment_id=c.reply_to_comment_id left join shop_user ru on ru.user_id=rc.shop_user_id
mapper.select: where c.post_id=#{postId} and c.parent_comment_id is null and c.del_flag='0' order by c.create_time desc,c.comment_id desc

select ranked.* from ( select c.*,u.user_name,u.nick_name,u.avatar,rc.shop_user_id reply_to_shop_user_id,coalesce(ru.nick_name,ru.user_name) reply_to_name,c.shop_user_id=p.shop_user_id post_author,0 reply_count, row_number() over(partition by c.parent_comment_id order by c.create_time,c.comment_id) reply_rank from shop_zhenke_post_comment c join shop_zhenke_post p on p.post_id=c.post_id and p.del_flag='0' join shop_user u on u.user_id=c.shop_user_id left join shop_zhenke_post_comment rc on rc.comment_id=c.reply_to_comment_id left join shop_user ru on ru.user_id=rc.shop_user_id where c.post_id=#{postId} and c.del_flag='0' and c.parent_comment_id in #{rootCommentId} ) ranked where ranked.reply_rank <= #{previewSize} order by ranked.parent_comment_id,ranked.create_time,ranked.comment_id
where c.post_id=#{postId} and c.parent_comment_id=#{rootCommentId} and c.del_flag='0' order by c.create_time,c.comment_id
where c.post_id=#{postId} and c.comment_id=#{commentId} and c.del_flag='0'

choose.when: insert into shop_zhenke_post_comment(post_id,parent_comment_id,reply_to_comment_id,shop_user_id,content,del_flag,create_time,update_time) select p.post_id,root.comment_id,target.comment_id,#{shopUserId},#{content},'0',sysdate(),sysdate() from shop_zhenke_post p join shop_zhenke_post_comment target on target.post_id=p.post_id and target.comment_id=#{replyToCommentId} and target.del_flag='0' join shop_zhenke_post_comment root on root.post_id=p.post_id and root.comment_id=coalesce(target.parent_comment_id,target.comment_id) and root.parent_comment_id is null and root.del_flag='0' where p.post_id=#{postId} and p.del_flag='0' and p.status='PUBLISHED'
choose.otherwise: insert into shop_zhenke_post_comment(post_id,parent_comment_id,reply_to_comment_id,shop_user_id,content,del_flag,create_time,update_time) select #{postId},null,null,#{shopUserId},#{content},'0',sysdate(),sysdate() from shop_zhenke_post where post_id=#{postId} and del_flag='0' and status='PUBLISHED'

mapper.update: update shop_zhenke_post_comment set del_flag='2',delete_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where post_id=#{postId} and comment_id=#{commentId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId} and del_flag='0'

update shop_zhenke_post_comment set del_flag='2',delete_time=sysdate(),update_time=sysdate() where post_id=#{postId} and del_flag='0' and (comment_id=#{commentId} or parent_comment_id=#{commentId}) and exists(select 1 from (select comment_id from shop_zhenke_post_comment where post_id=#{postId} and comment_id=#{commentId} and shop_user_id=#{shopUserId} and parent_comment_id is null and del_flag='0') owned)
mapper.select: select * from shop_home_banner where status='0' and (start_time is null or start_time<=sysdate()) and (end_time is null or end_time>sysdate()) order by banner_sort,banner_id limit 10
select * from shop_home_banner order by banner_sort,banner_id
select * from shop_home_banner where banner_id=#{id}
select count(*) from shop_merchant where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and audit_status='APPROVED' and status='0' and del_flag='0'

select merchant_id,coalesce(nullif(trim(shop_name),''),company_name) option_shop_name from shop_merchant where audit_status = 'APPROVED' and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
and (shop_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or company_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by update_time desc, merchant_id desc limit 30
